questions.question: Raman and Sanjay started a business by investing Rs. 63000 and Rs. 42000 respectively. If the total profit at the end of year is Rs. 9000, then what is the share of Raman?
questions.solution:
As we know that the investment ratio is equal to the profit ratio

The ratio of investment of Raman to Sanjay = 63000 : 42000 = 3 :2

⇒ The ratio of their profit is also 3 : 2

⇒ The profit share of Raman = 9000 × 3/5

∴ The profit share of Raman is Rs. 5400

questions.question: A train starts from A at 6 AM and reaches B at 11 AM on the same day. Another train starts from B at 8 AM and reaches A at 3 PM on the same day. At what time the two trains will have crossed each other?
questions.solution:
Let the distance between two station be x km

Since, the first train that travels from A to B covers the distance x in 5 hour

⇒ The speed of first train is x/5 km/hour

Since, the second train that travels from B to A covers the distance x in 7 hour

⇒ The speed of second train is x/7 km/hour

Now, in 2 hour the distance travelled by first train is 2x/5

⇒ The remaining distance is 3x/5

Now, let they start at 8:00 AM and they will meet after T hours with each other

⇒ x/5 × T + x/7 × T = 3X/5

⇒ T/5 + T/7 = 3/5

⇒ T = 1 hour 45 minutes

∴ The time at which they will meet = 8 : 00 AM + 1 hour 45 minutes = 9:45 AM

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 1200 is invested at compound interest (compounded half yearly). If the rate of interest is 10% per annum, then what will be the amount after 18 months?
questions.solution:
Given, principle is Rs. 1200, rate is compounded half yearly so R = 5%, and time = 18 months

Since, Amount = P (1 + R/100)ⁿ

⇒ Amount = 1200 (1 + 5/100)³

⇒ Amount = 1200 × 9261/8000

∴ Amount after 18 months will be Rs. 1389.15

questions.question: The length of one of the diagonals of a rhombus is 48 cm. If the side of the rhombus is 26 cm, then what is the area of the rhombus?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The diagonals of a rhombus are 48 cm

The side of the rhombus is 26 cm

**Calculation:**

Since, we know that d₁² + d₂² = 4a², where d1 and d2 are the diagonals of rhombus and a is the side

⇒ 48² + d₂² = 4 × 26²

⇒ d₂² = 2704 – 2304

⇒ d₂ = 20

Now, the area of rhombus = ½ × d₁ × d₂

The area of rhombus = ½ × 48 × 20

**∴ The area of rhombus is 480 cm²**

questions.question: If A is the smallest three digit number divisible by both 6 and 7 and B is the largest four digit number divisible by both 6 and 7, then what is the value of B – A?
questions.solution:
The smallest three digit number divisible by 6 and 7 is = 42 × 3 = 126

⇒ A = 126

And to find the largest four digit number digit number divisible by 6 and 7, we have to divide 9999 by 42

⇒ 9999 = 42 × 238 + 3

⇒ The largest four digit number divisible by 42 is 9999 – 3 = 9996

⇒ B = 9996

So, the required difference = 9996 – 126

∴ The difference between B and A is 9870

questions.question: What is the value of [2 of 3 ÷ 3 × 2 + {4 × 3 – (5 × 2 + 3)}]?
questions.solution:
Follow BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order is given below:

**Step-1: **Parts of an equation enclosed in 'Brackets' must be solved first and in the bracket,

**Step-2: **Any mathematical 'Of' or 'Exponent' must be solved next,

**Step-3:** Next, the parts of the equation that contain 'Division' and 'Multiplication' are calculated,

**Step-4:** Last but not least, the parts of the equation that contain 'Addition' and 'Subtraction' should be calculated.

[2 of 3 ÷ 3 × 2 + {4 × 3 – (5 × 2 + 3)}]

⇒ [2 of 3 ÷ 3 × 2 + {4 × 3 – 13}]

⇒ [2 of 3 ÷ 3 × 2 + (- 1)]

⇒ [6 ÷ 3 × 2 -1]

⇒ 2 × 2 – 1

∴ 3 is the right answer

questions.question: The ratio of the age of a father and his son is 3 : 1. If the product of their ages is 432, then what is the sum of their ages?
questions.solution:
Let the ratio be x

So, the age of father is 3x and the age of his son is x

According to question,

3x × x = 432

⇒ 3 x² = 432

⇒ x = 12

Now, the sum of their ages = 3x + x = 4x

⇒ 4 × 12

⇒ 48

∴ The sum of their ages is 48.

N and K together can complete a work in 240 days, K and G together can complete the same work in 72 days and N and G together can complete the same work in 80 days. In how many days K alone can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
Let the total work be 720 units

⇒ The work done by (N + K) is 3 units

⇒ The work done by (K + G) is 10 units

⇒ The work done by (N + G) is 9 units

⇒ The work done by (N + K +G) together is 11 units

⇒ The work done by K is (11 – 9) units = 2 unit

So, the K can complete the whole work in 720/2 days

∴ The time taken by K to complete the whole work is 360 days

questions.question: The present age of a Manoj is twice the sum of the ages of his two children. After 20 years, the age of Manoj will become equal to the sum of the ages of his two children. What is the present age of Manoj?
questions.solution:
Let the sum of present ages of children be x

So, the present ages of Manoj is 2x

After 20 years,

The sum of ages of children will be (x + 40)

And the age of Manoj will be (2x + 20)

Now, according to question

⇒ (2x + 20) = (x + 40)

⇒ x = 20

∴ The present age of Manoj = 20 × 2 = 40 years

questions.question: The profit earned on selling an article at Rs. 720 is half of the loss incurred on selling the same article at Rs. 360. What is the cost price of the article?
questions.solution:
Let the loss occurred on selling the article at Rs. 360 be Rs. x

So, the profit occurred on selling the article at Rs. 720 is Rs. x/2

Now, according to question

720 – x/2 = 360 + x

⇒ 3x/2 = 360

⇒ x = 240

Now, the cost price of article = 360 + x = 360 + 240

∴ The cost price is Rs. 600

questions.solution:

Average = sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

Given, the average of four numbers is 20

The sum of these four numbers is 80

And given that the average of the first two numbers is 15

The sum of the first two numbers is 30

The sum of the last two numbers = 80 – 30

⇒ 50

So, the average o
f the last two numbers = 50/2

∴ The required average = 25 

**∴ The average of the last two numbers is 25.**

questions.question: What is the circumference of the largest circle which can be inscribed in a square of side 14 cm? ( {Take pi = frac{{22}}{7}} )
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Side of square = 14cm

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b410ed10682368c7a002270b9b6e230dd49c8c611a0cf4105f65daf166885848.png] 

We know that the diameter of the circle that can be inscribed in a square is equal to the length of square

⇒ The diameter of circle = 14 cm

⇒ The radius of circle = 7 cm

⇒ The circumference of circle = 2 π r

⇒ 2 × 22/7 × 7

**∴ The required circumference = 44 cm**
